<subject>Reminder -- Last Day to Provide Input on Naming of Meridian Law & Advisory LLP Pro Bono Legal Clinic!</subject>
<body>
As Meridian Law & Advisory LLP finalizes plans for our pro bono legal clinic scheduled to open during the 3rd quarter of next year, we are seeking input on 5 alternative names/concepts for the naming of our clinic. If you've already given feedback, THANKS!

If you have not, please take 5 minutes of your time to stop by Room 49C3 from 11-1 TODAY to give us your opinion.

Feel free to bring a colleague! FREE biscuits will be provided!

Please forward this email to any other Meridian Law & Advisory LLP employees that may want to provide their input on the naming of the clinic.

We look forward to seeing you later today!

Regards,

Grace
</body>
